title: PHP2Shell: unauthenticated remote code execution in PHP core
summary_text: Two memory-safety flaws in how PHP handles out-of-memory errors during a request let a remote attacker without a login run code on the server. Application code does not matter. Every web SAPI is affected (mod_php, PHP-FPM, php-cgi, FrankenPHP, LiteSpeed). mod_php is the highest risk. The only complete fix is upgrading PHP. Edge WAF rules (for example Cloudflare's) cover known attack patterns only.
notes: CVSS v4 vector not recorded here; network_unauthenticated is set from the advisory text. Exploitation attempts were reported by Amazon (Oct 17) and watchTowr (Oct 21); not in CISA KEV at last check. Fixed in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35. Branches 8.1 and older get no official release (minimal source backports only), so they're marked unsupported.
